🚀 QUICKEST PATH (TEST IN 5 MINUTES):

Step 1: Download Expo Go on Android Phone
  → Google Play Store
  → Search "Expo Go"
  → Install

Step 2: Open Expo Go → Tap QR Scanner

Step 3: Point Camera at Terminal
  (Look for black & white QR code in terminal)

RESULT: ✅ App running on your phone!

═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

📦 PERMANENT APK (BUILD IN 20 MINUTES):

Step 1: Login
  $ eas login
  (Enter your Expo account email and password)

Step 2: Build
  $ eas build --platform android --profile preview
  (Takes 10-15 minutes, you'll get email with download link)

Step 3: Deploy
  $ adb install -r C:\path\to\app.apk
  (Deploy to connected phone)

RESULT: ✅ APK permanently on your phone!

═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

⚡ ONE-COMMAND QUICK BUILD:

Open PowerShell and run:

cd c:\Users\Vichu\OneDrive\Desktop\UrbanHelpersApp
eas login
eas build --platform android --profile preview

Then wait for email with APK download link!

🔧 BUILD METHOD COMPARISON:

Expo Go:
  • Time: 5 minutes
  • Setup: None (just download app)
  • Best for: Quick testing
  
EAS Build (Cloud):
  • Time: 20 minutes
  • Setup: Free Expo account
  • Best for: Permanent APK

Local Gradle:
  • Time: 10 minutes
  • Setup: Android SDK (complex)
  • Best for: Development
